verdict: Organic activity is softening across all three locations; paid channels remain dark.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all inbound activity across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision came entirely from organic Google Business Profile presence — combined, your three locations recorded 415 total profile actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks), with zero paid spend generating zero paid leads. Over the last 7 days, GBP engagement fell sharply at every location — down 55% at Forte, 60% at Advance Grinding, and 71% at O'Hare Precision — a consistent pattern pointing to softening organic search visibility rather than an isolated event at one location. Search clicks at O'Hare also declined 22% week-over-week, corroborating the trend. The web and SEO root cause has been identified and a fix is in motion, with site reindexing targeted for completion by end of October; CRM and outreach work currently in progress will unlock the contact sequences needed to build a pipeline independent of search volume. Once those blockers clear, outreach sequences and, where appropriate, paid activity can be activated to reduce dependence on organic alone.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply in the last 7 days at all three locations, with the final few days showing near-zero activity — consistent with a search visibility issue, not normal fluctuation.
watch_item.fix: The SEO root cause has been identified and submitted for correction; site reindexing is on track for October, which should restore organic visibility and stabilize profile traffic.
